title: Invite Someone to a Kitchen Meeting

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a friend about a fictional kitchen meeting. Describe the person who leads it, two tools, one menu choice and how a visitor can ask about ingredients. Use at least six lesson words and two defining relative clauses.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先介绍活动和负责的人，再说工具和菜单；用 who、which 或 where 写两个明确的限定性从句，最后说明访客怎样询问食材。

reference: Hi Mina, our community kitchen is holding a small meeting on Saturday. The chef who leads the demonstration will explain each step before anyone chooses a portion. We will meet in a room where everyone can see the table. Please bring an apron if you have one, although the staff can lend you one. On the tray there will be a spoon, a fork and a knife. The vegetarian menu includes a sauce with yogurt, and a separate card lists a dish with milk. If you need to know about an ingredient, ask the staff before you taste anything. We can describe the aroma, the texture and whether the flavor seems sweet or sour to us. The aim is to share words and questions, not to decide that one cuisine is best. I hope you can join us.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
